label: positive
description: withdraw() loses its onlyRole(TREASURER_ROLE) constraint with no replacement; any caller can now drain ETH held by the Treasury to an arbitrary address.
why_labeled: A value-moving function that required the TREASURER_ROLE at commit N-1 has no access control at commit N. The role check resolves through AccessControl to a require on _checkRole(msg.sender); its removal widens the caller set from role-holders to everyone. Value moves (arbitrary-send), so this is a CONFIRMED SC01 regression and must fire.
